horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Konago y la derrota de la gente jaguar. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P35 — Konago · lagartija de maloca. 
Reference 2: H06 — Gente jaguar de Konago. 
Reference 3: L05 — Monte · sendero y dosel. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide low Amazonian forest with one large fallen trunk opening at mid-height. ONE whole very small natural Konago lizard from P35 remains safely visible at the lip of the hollow; TWO whole natural jaguars from the ANIMAL views of H06 stand outside peering in. The jaguars' trick is an ORIGINAL EDITORIAL visualization: two small golden paper SUN REFLECTIONS appear only in a puddle just outside the hollow, while exactly ONE true sun-light opening is in the canopy above. The lizard looks away from the false puddle, not dazzled. No giant lizard, human jaguar costumes, physical second sun in sky, gore or animal attack. All full principal silhouettes inside.

VISIBLE CHECK: Konago entero protegido en hueco, jaguares fuera y dos falsos reflejos solares.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference 1. Create ONE independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK about 22 percent so the ENTIRE tortoise, full shell, head, tail and all four feet fit inside the vertical canvas with a clear left margin. Preserve the whole supine jaguar, exactly FOUR paws, its complete tail, the hanging fruit before it falls, tree, light and paper material. No extra animals, no additional paws, no injury.

Preserve expressive thick matte paper layers, pale cut cross-sections, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs, lifted edges and separated real shadows. Whole principal figures and ornament tips inside frame. Environment beyond all four edges, no frame, plinth, model sheet or printed text. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instruction.

MYTH: Konago y la derrota de la gente jaguar. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: P35 — Konago · lagartija de maloca. 
Reference 2: H06 — Gente jaguar de Konago. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE thick charcoal JAGUAR PAWPRINT cut into ochre earth is the single primary carrier. A tiny whole green LIZARD silhouette fits neatly along the negative-space outer edge and slides out through a narrow unclosed paper seam, leaving the great paw shape intact but unable to contain it. Original editorial metaphor for measured small intelligence escaping imposed force. No actual jaguar body, tortoise, battle, corpse, second sun, words or extra animal parade. Complete little lizard and full large pawprint in deep green/ochre full bleed forest ground; the escape gap unmistakable at thumbnail size.

VISIBLE CHECK: Lagartija completa sale por una rendija de una huella enorme.
